criteria.method:
Measurement contract: For an exact completed native workspace window, the registered instrument reports observed per-leg server-issued push counts, closed-window counts and observability limits. Server hook/coord response issuance is labelled as issued; client receipt and attention remain explicitly unmeasured.

Run code-intel:native-push-issued-measured through scorecards:emit { fromLedger:true } on the containing staging-operator current build, using an exact completed native workspace window. Pass requires a nonempty applicable push population and per-observed-leg issued counts. No rows rates unknown. The evidence must identify workspace, exact [windowStart, windowEnd), containing current-build runtime and source, every observed leg, and cannotObserve. This criterion does not assert confirmed client delivery or usefulness. Verify its detector with the maintained native-adoption.test.ts and native-adoption.integration.test.ts suites; source qualification is recorded in docs/evidence/native-p041-reader-2026-10-16.json. Bind the instrument outcome separately from the detector tests. Reuse the existing rubric-rescore schedule; retain D-011 unchanged.

The negative requires lsp:apply to need intel:write and that capability to remain absent for judge. Separately verify the actual deployed release-operator artifact with an authenticated signed judge principal: record its serving health/build SHA, effective role/capability identity, exact requests and responses, and invocation-ledger references for nonempty scoped read fixtures through all four read tools. Exercise the denied-write admission control with no source mutation. The release artifact must contain the intended P040 access change, and the source fixture must have a known nonempty answer. Refused reads or an admitted write fails. Missing artifact/identity/read/negative-control evidence is unknown, never pass.
